title: ESPN FPI per-game predictor - harvested, falsified, parked

coverage.note: 100% of frozen filter; lastModified post-game but gameProjection equals the winprobability series play-1 value (verified 2017_14_SF_HOU et al), i.e. a pre-game snapshot

falsifier_results.verdict: FPI adds ZERO margin accuracy to the close at any blend weight.

stratified_fade_test.rule: when |FPI - close| >= 4 pts, bet FPI's side vs the close at -110
stratified_fade_test.interpretation: FPI-fade is NEGATIVELY edged - FPI overreacts; the market already knows.

falsifier_results.season_stability: market-side rate ranges 0.433-0.679 by season - unstable, no persistent signal

verdict.as_strategy: REFUSED. No ATS edge in either direction; permutation p=0.12.
verdict.as_covariate: PARKED for the GSE covariate bench: FPI win prob + predPtDiff are causally-safe pre-game model opinions; useful only if a future bind needs an independent prior where the market is unavailable (e.g. 2023 W2-5 where no opening line exists).
verdict.honesty: The headline finding is NEGATIVE: two independent probes (line movement, FPI) both confirm the close is the efficient frontier. Emission stays ZERO_OBJECT.
